paragraphs: Creditspring’s mission to boost financial stability through subscription products mirrors my recent work building an agentic tool that streamlines decision‑making for a Madrid‑based start‑up, where I proposed and prototyped FastMCP using Python, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and showcased it in a live stakeholder demo.

I built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker, ensuring rapid, reliable model delivery and easy integration into existing workflows.

Could we arrange a brief call so I can walk you through how my experience with agentic tools and containerised model services could help Creditspring deliver resilient, subscription‑based financial products?
